description: CALWF Prompt 矩阵 - 3 题目 × 4 水平 = 12 个 prompt

prompts.text:
Write an argumentative essay on the following topic. State your opinion clearly and support it with reasons and examples.

Topic: Nowadays, people pay more and more attention to degree certificates. In many institutions, one's promotion is primarily decided by whether one has obtained a graduate degree or not. A growing number of critics say that if this tendency goes to the extreme, young people may be misled. A degree certificate can reflect only one's academic achievements but not all abilities essential for a successful career.

Write an essay of approximately 150 words.
